description.value:
As part of the action you use to cast this power, you make a melee weapon attack against a creature within your reach; if you don't, the power fails. On a hit, the target suffers the attack's normal effects, and you ward yourself through the Force. If that same target forces you to make a saving throw before the start of your next turn, it takes an extra 1d6 psychic damage and you add the result of a d4 you roll to your saving throw; the power then ends.

At 5th level, the initial melee attack deals an extra 1d6 psychic damage, and the retaliatory psychic damage increases to 2d6; both increase by another 1d6 at 11th and again at 17th level.

system.source: EC Powers — Light Side Powers, At-Will
